sections.title: Timing File Operations
sections.content:
Create test_file.txt and time reading it. Bash labels real/user/sys differ from Zsh examples.

```bash
echo "This is a test file for TechInnovate's performance analysis." > test_file.txt
time cat test_file.txt
```
sections.content_vi:
Tạo test_file.txt rồi đo thời gian đọc. Bash hiển thị real/user/sys khác ví dụ Zsh.

```bash

time cat test_file.txt
```

sections.title: Timing Complex Commands
sections.content:
Create and time the log-processing script.

```bash
cat > process_logs.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..1000}; do echo "Processing log entry $i" >> output.log; done
sort output.log > sorted_output.log
uniq -c sorted_output.log > final_output.log
rm output.log sorted_output.log
SH
chmod +x process_logs.sh
time ./process_logs.sh
```
sections.content_vi:
Tạo và đo thời gian script xử lý log.

```bash
cat > process_logs.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..1000}; do echo "Processing log entry $i" >> output.log; done
sort output.log > sorted_output.log
uniq -c sorted_output.log > final_output.log
rm output.log sorted_output.log
SH
chmod +x process_logs.sh
time ./process_logs.sh
```

checks.command:
set -e
cd /home/labex/project/
test -x process_logs.sh
test "$(wc -l < final_output.log)" -eq 1000
test ! -e output.log
test ! -e sorted_output.log

sections.title: Using time with Different Commands
sections.content:
Time a numeric pipeline, file search and passwd sort. Runtime values vary.

```bash
time echo {1..10000} | wc -w
time find / -name "*.txt" 2>/dev/null
time sort -R /etc/passwd | head -n 5
```
sections.content_vi:
Đo pipeline số, tìm tệp và sắp xếp passwd. Thời gian thực tế có thể khác.

```bash
time echo {1..10000} | wc -w
time find / -name "*.txt" 2>/dev/null
time sort -R /etc/passwd | head -n 5
```
